name: 翼龙
description: 拥有庞大的身躯，肚子总是鼓鼓的，充满发酵的食物。它有力的双翼和坚韧的躯体仿佛为长途飞行而生，在疾飞时仍能自由呼吸。
descriptionEn: It has a huge body with a constantly bulging belly full of fermented food. Its powerful wings and tough body seem built for long-distance flight, and it can still breathe freely even at high speed.
